source.state: Working tree including pre-existing uncommitted changes; extraction was not an immutable commit snapshot.

definitions.source-rendered: Direct React static render with representative fixture data and computed browser geometry.
definitions.source-guided: Editable reconstruction following source structure and styling; not a pixel-identical runtime capture.
definitions.source-assembled: Full-screen composition combining directly rendered blocks and source-guided content.

limitations: Named editable groups; no linked component instances.
Static states and representative data; not an exhaustive interactive state machine.
Shader layers are frozen raster frames; UI text, shapes and vectors are editable.
Absolute geometry extracted at fixed sizes; typography/spacing changes need a layout review.
No automatic synchronization from Paper back to source code.
Source-guided specimens and assembled screens require verification against the running application before implementation.

paperOnlyRepairs: Transparent and OKLab SVG paint converted to compatible RGB/opacity.
Textarea labels and display:contents flattened for Paper.
Resizable demo height and chart label positions adjusted after static rendering.
Shimmer text represented by a static muted fill.
Native range input reconstructed as track/thumb layers.
New-chat Composer placeholder and disabled send state corrected.
Brand color swatch fixed to match its displayed hex value.
